end_goal:
Write complete, production-ready Rust code for the ghostwriter project. Output only code blocks that can be copied directly into project files — no prose between code blocks, no placeholder TODOs.

Work through the pending issues in priority order:

1. ISSUE 1 — Wire Navigator into engine.rs:
   - Update typer/engine.rs `run()` signature to accept `nav: &mut Navigator`
   - Replace all `code --goto` CLI calls with `nav.open(path)` for CreateFile, EditFile, MoveCursor
   - Update main.rs cmd_run() to pass nav into the engine

   - If collapsed: click the expand arrow, wait for VSCode animation, verify

3. ISSUE 3 — Two-phase task execution in orchestrator/mod.rs:
   - Phase 1: execute all GenerateStub and DescribeTransition tasks (independent, can parallelise)
   - Phase 2: build GenerateIntermediates tasks using Phase 1 stub results, then execute
   - Preserve existing assembler integration and file-level caching

4. ISSUE 4 & 5 — Complete engine.rs CreateFile and EditFile:
   - CreateFile: open file via nav.open(), human-type stub, apply intermediates, apply final edits via find+replace
   - EditFile: for each Edit { find, replace } open Ctrl+H, fill find/replace fields, execute, close

5. ISSUE 6 — RunCommand terminal integration:
   - Open VSCode integrated terminal with Ctrl+backtick
   - Human-type the command string, press Enter
   - Wait for prompt return before proceeding
success_criteria: Complete, compiling Rust code for all six issues. No stubs, no TODOs. Ready to copy into ghostwriter source files.
hard_constraints: Output only copy-paste-ready Rust code blocks. Minimal prose — just enough to identify which file each block belongs to.
All enigo coordinates must be logical pixels (physical pixels divided by scale_factor from VscodeLayout).
VisualDictionary keys are always relative paths — never absolute.
Preserve existing function signatures unless the issue explicitly requires changing them.
No partial implementations — if you open a function, complete it.
No new Cargo.toml dependencies — use only crates already in the ghostwriter Cargo.toml.
background_context:
ghostwriter is a Rust CLI (edition 2021) that drives VSCode to simulate a human coding session from a GitHub repo.

MODULE MAP:
  src/main.rs                   — subcommand dispatch: run | resume | check | plan
  src/cli.rs                    — clap Cli + Command enum + per-subcommand Args structs
  src/config.rs                 — Config struct, ghostwriter.toml loading
  src/session.rs                — SessionState, .ghostwriter/session.toml read/write
  src/orchestrator/
    analyzer.rs                 — FileInfo, FileCategory, Complexity, dep graph
    stage_planner.rs            — StagePlan, topological sort (Kahn's), depth buckets
    tasks.rs                    — AiTask / AiResult enums + JSON parsing
    script.rs                   — DevelopmentScript, Stage, Action types (serde)
    assembler.rs                — AI results → DevelopmentScript + diff hunks
    llm.rs                      — reqwest wrapper for Anthropic API
    prompt.rs                   — build_prompt() dispatcher
    prompts/stub.rs             — GenerateStub prompt template
    prompts/intermediates.rs    — GenerateIntermediates prompt template
    prompts/describe.rs         — DescribeTransition prompt template
  src/navigator/
    mod.rs                      — Navigator struct: bootstrap() and open()
    bootstrap.rs                — 9-step bootstrap sequence → BootstrapResult
    bootstrap_error.rs          — BootstrapError enum (14 variants), print_fatal()
    calibrator.rs               — capture_new_file() for mid-playback template capture
    dictionary.rs               — VisualDictionary: load/save/insert/update_position
    mouse.rs                    — Bézier mouse movement + click
    screen.rs                   — capture_screen(), Rect, scale_down()
    sidebar.rs                  — probe_sidebar(), find_selected_row(), crop_row(), ensure_parents_expanded() stub
    template.rs                 — NCC find() and find_near() via imageproc
  src/typer/
    engine.rs                   — script runner: stage × action loop — INCOMPLETE
    human.rs                    — HumanSimulator: log-normal delays, QWERTY typos, 4 typo kinds
    editor.rs                   — VSCode commands: goto_line, select, find+replace
    input.rs                    — low-level enigo key/text injection helpers
    vscode.rs                   — open(), focus(), CLI (code --goto)

KEY DATA STRUCTURES:
  DevelopmentScript { stages: Vec<Stage> }
  Stage { name: String, description: String, actions: Vec<Action> }
  Action::CreateFile { path, stub, intermediates: Vec<String>, final_content, edits: Vec<Edit> }
  Action::EditFile  { path, edits: Vec<Edit> }
  Action::MoveCursor { path, line: u32 }
  Action::RunCommand { command: String }
  Action::ThinkPause { duration_ms: u64 }
  Action::DeleteFile { path }
  Edit { find: String, replace: String }
  VisualDictionary { entries: HashMap<PathBuf, DictEntry>, sidebar_region: Rect }
  DictEntry { template: DynamicImage, last_known_y: Option<u32>, confidence: f32 }
  VscodeLayout { scale_factor: f64, display_width: u32, display_height: u32, row_height_px: u32 }
  BootstrapResult { dictionary: VisualDictionary, layout: VscodeLayout }
  MatchResult { x: u32, y: u32, score: f32 }  — score >= 0.82 is a match

CRITICAL INVARIANTS:
  - screen.rs coordinates are always physical pixels
  - enigo coordinates are always logical pixels (physical ÷ scale_factor)
  - Templates stored in physical pixels; NCC converts both sides to logical before comparing
  - VisualDictionary keys are relative paths (e.g. src/main.rs), never absolute
  - DevelopmentScript is immutable after generation — engine reads, never writes
  - All AI responses must be JSON — parsers in tasks.rs have no prose fallback
  - BootstrapError::print_fatal() must fire before the error is converted to anyhow

SEQUENCING CONSTRAINTS (violating causes subtle bugs):
  1. Bootstrap must run on the source repo, not the destination
  2. GenerateIntermediates requires stub_content from GenerateStub for the same file
  3. Wire Navigator into engine before implementing CreateFile/EditFile
  4. Physical pixel coordinates must be divided by scale_factor before passing to enigo
  5. ensure_parents_expanded() must be called before every nav.open()

PENDING ISSUES (priority order):
  Issue 1: engine.rs uses `code --goto` for file switching instead of nav.open()
  Issue 2: sidebar::ensure_parents_expanded() is a TODO stub
  Issue 3: orchestrator/mod.rs runs all tasks in one phase; GenerateIntermediates needs Stub result first
  Issue 4: engine.rs CreateFile multi-step progression not implemented
  Issue 5: engine.rs EditFile find+replace sequence not implemented
  Issue 6: engine.rs RunCommand terminal integration not implemented

WHAT WORKS END-TO-END:
  repo::fetch(), orchestrator::orchestrate(), navigator::bootstrap()
  typer::human (timing + typos), typer::editor (VSCode commands), typer::vscode (open/focus)
tech_constraints: Rust edition 2021. ghostwriter Cargo.toml dependencies only — no new crates. macOS primary target; cross-platform where existing code already handles it.
